name: Massage therapy

services.name: 30-min massage
services.story: The main story: a $35 30-min massage with Luis. A card is saved for the studio's $20 fee. Alex pays at the front desk, with any tip.

services.name: 30-min massage

B.staff: Ethan and Leah (massage therapists who travel)

services.name: 90-min massage at home
services.story: The main story: a $179 90-min massage at Alex's home. A card is saved for the $89 late-cancel and no-show fee. Rosie texts the bill, with a tip line, when Ethan texts DONE.

services.name: 90-min massage at home
services.story: The same massage at home. A card is saved, and it's charged $179 when Ethan texts DONE.

services.name: 60-min massage at home
services.story: A $150 60-min massage at Alex's home, paid in full when booking. A hotel visit is always paid this way.

services_shape: set sessions by length, with a therapist the client picks or any free one; add-ons; packs of sessions, memberships and gift cards
questions_before_times: the length and kind of massage (relaxing, deep tissue, prenatal, hot stones)
a therapist by name, or a woman or a man, only if the client asks
for a teen: the age (13 to 17); a parent or guardian books
away from the studio: what kind of place (a home, a hotel, an office) and the town, before any times
safety_stop: chest pain, trouble breathing, sudden numbness or weakness in the legs, loss of bladder or bowel control
a calf that is red, swollen and painful (it can be a blood clot)
license: always: massage therapy is licensed where the state's rules require it; many states license each therapist, and some cities or states also license the place
staff_skills: Swedish, deep tissue, sports, prenatal, hot stones, chair massage, couples lessons; only therapists trained in prenatal massage are offered for it
messages_never: health answers, pregnancy, injuries, medicines, a doctor's note and the therapist's notes never go in a text or through the AI: only the secure page and the client's private record; a hotel room number only on the secure page
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
